resources.string: Topics, study sessions and the time before your exams.
All active exams in this teaching account share one daily budget. Separate accounts remain independent.
Review and save this teaching account’s budget before generating sessions.
Source or local data needs attention. Refresh or resolve workload limitations before generating a draft.
Unknown exam ends block later time conservatively. Enter a personal exam duration to make a planning assumption explicit.
Earliest exams and free intervals first. A draft is checked jointly; unplaced work does not prove no other arrangement exists.
Archived: future sessions are excluded from planning. Completed preparation is retained.
The saved exam has changed, passed or is unavailable. Choose a replacement explicitly, or archive this plan; history stays intact.
Add topics and enter total effort. No effort is inferred from exam type or course credits.
Add topics, review the budget, then generate a draft. Saving is explicit.
Planning data could not be read. Existing data is retained; reload to retry.
Changes were not saved. Your draft stays open; reload if another edit changed the workspace.
Check the fields, preserved effort, current availability and daily budget. Your draft remains open.
Source or planning data changed. Generate a fresh draft before saving.
Resolve changed exams, data limitations, locked-session conflicts or session rules before saving a generated plan.
Draft generated. Review every session and unplaced topic before saving.
Revision planning uses an explicitly selected DAA or Portal exam source and its own saved budget.
No upcoming exams are cached. Refresh the teaching account from the workspace.
Link changes are explicit. Existing topics and completed sessions are preserved; duplicate exam links are rejected.
Total includes reported completed effort. Editing clears this topic’s unlocked future sessions; completed, missed and locked history remains. Effort is not added to workload estimates automatically.
Minimum session, windows, daily budgets and finish lead come from Configure budget. Breaks reserve time, not study-budget minutes. A short final effort still reserves a full minimum-length session.
Moves must fit current conservative availability, the exam cutoff, shared budgets and breaks. A shorter reservation reduces its credited effort. History is never moved.
Permanently remove this plan, its topics and all session history from this device. Archive instead to retain completed preparation. University data is unaffected.
A fixed session conflicts with recorded availability, a cutoff or another session. Move, unlock or skip it explicitly.
Fixed or completed sessions exceed a daily budget. Review the budget or fixed sessions.
The 2,048-session storage limit was reached. Remove an old local plan deliberately before retrying.
Maximum session length must be at least the configured minimum.
Planning reached its search limit. Shorten the horizon or simplify fixed reservations, then try again. This draft was not saved.
